name: AV-6R7
description: AV-6R7 was an Imperial V-series droid supervisor manufactured by MerenData. The supervisor droid oversaw work droids building the Empire's Death Star II superweapon by 4 ABY and was serving in that year on the Super Star Destroyer Executor during the Battle of Endor, with the Executor colliding with the Death Star in the course of the battle.
